description: This file defines a final class 'Constants' that contains various public static final String and int constants used throughout the wearable quiz application. It includes keys for passing data between components and some path constants for messaging, as well as timeout values.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A utility class containing constant values used for data keying and messaging paths in the wearable quiz app.

methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the utility class.
